! JO9 MOD START FARID_CONSIGNMENT_STORAGE_20261028 ! Stored actors use the existing complete instance variable schema. ! They are not added to owned actor, daily update or liquidation rosters. local $jo9_fc_mode = $args[0] local $jo9_fc_source = $args[1] local $jo9_fc_target = $args[2] local jo9_fc_i, $jo9_fc_from_var, $jo9_fc_to_var, jo9_fc_ok, jo9_fc_amount, $jo9_fc_panel result = 0 if arrsize('$slave_vars') < 1: exit if $jo9_fc_mode = 'copy': if ($jo9_fc_source = 'stock' and $jo9_fc_target = 'jo9_farid_stored') or ($jo9_fc_source = 'jo9_farid_stored' and ($jo9_fc_target = 'slave' or $jo9_fc_target = 'jo9_farid_viewprobe')): if dyneval('result = ' + $jo9_fc_source + '_state') ! CONST_INT['slave_exist']: exit for jo9_fc_i = 0 to arrsize('$slave_vars') - 1: $jo9_fc_from_var = replace($slave_vars[jo9_fc_i], 'instance', $jo9_fc_source) $jo9_fc_to_var = replace($slave_vars[jo9_fc_i], 'instance', $jo9_fc_target) killvar $jo9_fc_to_var copyarr $jo9_fc_to_var, $jo9_fc_from_var end if dyneval('result = ' + $jo9_fc_target + '_state') ! CONST_INT['slave_exist']: exit if dyneval('result = ' + $jo9_fc_target + "['id']") ! dyneval('result = ' + $jo9_fc_source + "['id']"): exit if dyneval('result = ' + $jo9_fc_target + '_type') ! dyneval('result = ' + $jo9_fc_source + '_type'): exit if $dyneval('$result = $' + $jo9_fc_target + '_name') ! $dyneval('$result = $' + $jo9_fc_source + '_name'): exit result = 1 end exit end if $jo9_fc_mode = 'clear': if $jo9_fc_source ! 'stock' and $jo9_fc_source ! 'jo9_farid_stored' and $jo9_fc_source ! 'jo9_farid_viewprobe': exit for jo9_fc_i = 0 to arrsize('$slave_vars') - 1: $jo9_fc_to_var = replace($slave_vars[jo9_fc_i], 'instance', $jo9_fc_source) killvar $jo9_fc_to_var end if $jo9_fc_source = 'jo9_farid_stored': jo9_farid_stored_valid = 0 if $jo9_fc_source = 'jo9_farid_viewprobe': killvar '$jo9_farid_viewprobe_features_list' result = 1 exit end if $jo9_fc_mode = 'deposit': if stock_state ! CONST_INT['slave_exist']: exit gs '$slave_price', 'stock' jo9_fc_amount = slaveprice / 2 if jo9_fc_amount < 1: exit jo9_fc_ok = func('jo9_farid_consignment', 'copy', 'stock', 'jo9_farid_stored') if jo9_fc_ok ! 1: exit ! Keep the original latest-one-returnable rule for repeated deposits. farid_debt += farid_potential_debt farid_potential_debt = jo9_fc_amount jo9_farid_stored_valid = 1 jo9_fc_ok = func('jo9_farid_consignment', 'clear', 'stock') result = 1 exit end if $jo9_fc_mode = 'return': if farid_potential_debt <= 0: result = -1 & exit if slave_state ! CONST_INT['no_slave']: result = -2 & exit ! Legacy saves have no receipt proving the identity of shared stock. if jo9_farid_stored_valid ! 1 or jo9_farid_stored_state ! CONST_INT['slave_exist']: result = -3 & exit jo9_fc_ok = func('jo9_farid_consignment', 'copy', 'jo9_farid_stored', 'slave') if jo9_fc_ok ! 1: exit sparks -= 5 farid_potential_debt = 0 jo9_fc_ok = func('jo9_farid_consignment', 'clear', 'jo9_farid_stored') master_moodlet['pos_new_slave'] = 6 - brand_reputation result = 1 exit end if $jo9_fc_mode = 'settle': if farid_potential_debt < 0: exit jo9_fc_amount = farid_potential_debt farid_debt += jo9_fc_amount farid_potential_debt = 0 jo9_fc_ok = func('jo9_farid_consignment', 'clear', 'jo9_farid_stored') result = jo9_fc_amount exit end if $jo9_fc_mode = 'collect': if farid_debt <= 0: exit jo9_fc_amount = farid_debt sparks += jo9_fc_amount farid_debt = 0 ! An older payment must not erase a newer pending consignment. if farid_potential_debt <= 0: jo9_fc_ok = func('jo9_farid_consignment', 'clear', 'jo9_farid_stored') result = jo9_fc_amount exit end if $jo9_fc_mode = 'panel': $info_bar = '위탁 인물의 보관 기록을 확인할 수 없습니다.' if jo9_farid_stored_valid ! 1 or jo9_farid_stored_state ! CONST_INT['slave_exist']: exit jo9_fc_ok = func('jo9_farid_consignment', 'copy', 'jo9_farid_stored', 'jo9_farid_viewprobe') if jo9_fc_ok ! 1: exit !Stock Traits ! JO9 MOD START COG_STOCK_DISPLAY | 2026-10-16_innate_learning_traits $jo9_farid_viewprobe_features_list = '' if jo9_farid_viewprobe['jo9_learning_trait'] = 1: $jo9_farid_viewprobe_features_list += '<>
' if jo9_farid_viewprobe['jo9_learning_trait'] = -1: $jo9_farid_viewprobe_features_list += '<>
' ! JO9 MOD END COG_STOCK_DISPLAY ! JO9 MOD END TRAITS_DISPLAY_STOCK_COG_STOCK_DISPLAY sanity = jo9_farid_viewprobe['ego'] + jo9_farid_viewprobe['temper'] + jo9_farid_viewprobe['pride'] if sanity < 3: $jo9_farid_viewprobe_features_list += '정신 상태
' elseif sanity < 5: $jo9_farid_viewprobe_features_list += '정신 상태
' end !if jo9_farid_viewprobe['brand'] = 0: $jo9_farid_viewprobe_features_list += 'Not Branded
' if jo9_farid_viewprobe['wounds'] > 0: $jo9_farid_viewprobe_features_list += '<<$wounds[jo9_farid_viewprobe["wounds"]]>>
' if jo9_farid_viewprobe['scars'] > 0: $jo9_farid_viewprobe_features_list += '<<$scars[jo9_farid_viewprobe["scars"]]>>
' if jo9_farid_viewprobe['bruises'] > 0: $jo9_farid_viewprobe_features_list += '<<$bruises[jo9_farid_viewprobe["bruises"]]>>

' end end if jo9_farid_viewprobe['rehabilitation'] > 0: $jo9_farid_viewprobe_features_list += '회복 [<>]

' end !if jo9_farid_viewprobe['fertility'] = -2: $jo9_farid_viewprobe_features_list += 'Immature

<<$jo9_farid_viewprobe_features_list>>' is_stock = 1 gs '$slave_price', 'jo9_farid_viewprobe' $info_bar = '노예 등급: <<$rating[rating]>>
